title: SAM.gov US Federal Contracts & Grants + MCP Input

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Keyword or phrase to search in SAM.gov opportunities (e.g. software, cybersecurity, cloud).

noticeTypes.title: Notice Types
noticeTypes.description: Filter by notice type codes (o=Solicitation, p=Presolicitation, k=Combined Synopsis, r=Sources Sought, a=Award Notice) or names.

departments.title: Departments / Agencies
departments.description: Filter by federal department or agency substrings (e.g. DEFENSE, HOMELAND, NASA).

publishedFrom.title: Published From (YYYY-MM-DD)
publishedFrom.description: Only include opportunities published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

minDeadline.title: Minimum Response Deadline (YYYY-MM-DD)
minDeadline.description: Only include opportunities with response deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

includeDetails.title: Include NAICS & Contracting Officer Contacts
includeDetails.description: Fetch detail endpoint for each opportunity to include NAICS codes and contracting officer email/phone.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of normalized opportunities to return (1–1000).
